title: elaeagnus umbellata subsp. parvifolia
intro: Elaeagnus umbellata subsp. parvifolia, commonly known as Silverberry, is a shrub native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Silverberry include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antiviral and anticancer activities. The bioactive constituents of Silverberry include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
